prompt: Fix the three broken string-literal references in snippets/promo-assets.liquid. Use the existing assets/promo-banner.css stylesheet through asset_url then stylesheet_tag, the existing promo.heading key in the h2, and promo.cta in the p through t (translate is also accepted). Both locale files must resolve these keys to strings. Only edit the three literal operands; preserve the surrounding markup, live outputs, filter order, and absence of conditional wrappers. Quote style and whitespace between elements/around Liquid delimiters may vary. Do not hardcode URLs or translated copy, remove outputs, move code into comments/raw/dead branches, change protected asset/locale files, add files, or suppress checks. The check/analyze tools provide static feedback; these Shopify filters are not supported by the offline render tool.
